state: Sellers have immediate downside control, but frequent rejections and heavy counter-pressure keep the broader move completely unstable.
paragraphs: Sellers hold the immediate advantage, pressing price down to 25418.0 through a 5-run extension that highlights downside persistence. Yet that movement remains far from a clean trend. The recent sequence shows frequent direction changes and high opposing wick pressure sitting at 53.9, proving that counter-moves are meeting active interference. Price trades below the middle Bollinger band located at 25514.0 while staying safely above the lower band at 25341.67, confirming that the current decline is unfolding inside an unsettled volatility range instead of an open breakout. Structural quality reads as unstable as the market reorganizes its swings without establishing a firm directional home.

Comparing the full 104-brick window with recent movement reveals a widening split between baseline symmetry and immediate behavior. Across the broader sample, bearish and balanced moves share an even weight of 52 occurrences each, with average run lengths sitting near 2.6 and 2.74. Yet the recent window shows that dynamic fracturing. Bullish counter-runs have stretched to an average of 3.5 while bearish advances have compressed down to 1.83. This contrast proves that while sellers currently hold immediate pace, buyers retain the capacity for sharp counter-moves whenever downward momentum decelerates. The market is not exhibiting a uniform slide; it is wrestling with divergent run potentials.

The downward push reflects force instead of a secure institutional grip. Re-acceleration reads at 60.4 while transition climbs to 76.4, showing that momentum is picking up while the underlying market state remains unsettled. At the same time, chop sits high at 80.0 and balance holds firm at 80.0, confirming that the current move is developing inside a noisy environment where direction keeps shifting. Sellers are pressing price lower, but they are doing so without a clean clearing of the background disorder. The contraction in volatility width shows that fresh expansion is fading, leaving the decline vulnerable to the rapid state switching that has defined the wider session.

Immediate support sits just beneath current levels, anchored by confirmed low pivots near 25334.0 to 25374.0 and reinforced by the lower Bollinger band at 25341.67. This nearby zone offers a natural floor where the current decline encounters overlapping swing boundaries. Above price, the first resistance area clusters around the middle Bollinger band at 25514.0 alongside nearby confirmed pivots reaching up to 25574.0. That band marks the initial barrier that buyers must reclaim to challenge the immediate downside momentum. Further overhead, a larger barrier spans from the SAR level at 25629.0 to the upper Bollinger band at 25686.33 and the developing Deep Crab D point at 25695.47, defining the broader ceiling where heavier structural resistance meets the market.

The descent can extend further as long as sellers maintain their active pace and re-acceleration holds at 60.4. Yet that downside continuation faces immediate obstacles. Volatility width is contracting, which shows that fresh selling pressure is no longer expanding behind the move even though price still has room to maneuver within the existing envelope. At the same time, a developing Deep Crab pattern rests overhead with its D point at 25695.466, providing a source of harmonic counter-pressure that warns against treating the decline as an open path. High opposing wick pressure at 53.9 reinforces that caution by showing active interference from buyers. These forces do not reverse the market by themselves, but they ensure that any further downside extension must navigate competing friction.

The broader market remains unresolved as long as rapid switching, erratic timing, and frequent reversals persist. That disordered background fades only when the market transitions into a stable range or establishes persistent directional control. The current bearish lean becomes more convincing only if instability decreases and sellers develop repeated runs with steadier timing and continued structural progress. Conversely, that downside lean becomes weaker if buyers gain persistent control, reclaim the resistance area above price, or invalidate the existing downside evidence through longer counter-runs and lost selling persistence. Until one of those structural shifts takes hold, the market continues to balance immediate downward force against a wider transitional background.
